description: Implementation of SHA1 hashing algorithm optimized for word access, including functions for initializing, updating, and finalizing SHA1 hashes, based on Mozilla's SHA1 implementation.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Init
methods.description: Initializes SHA1 context with standard constants.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Update
methods.description: Processes input data in chunks, updating the SHA1 context.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Final
methods.description: Finalizes the SHA1 hash and outputs the digest.

methods.name: blk_SHA1_Block
methods.description: Processes a 512-bit block of data to update the hash state.
